Empire Casting House is a New York-based wholesale jewelry manufacturer specializing in custom and ready-made jewelry pieces. The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including 3D CAD design, printing, casting, setting, and finishing, catering to jewelers seeking high-quality and ethically sourced jewelry.
History
Founded in 2017, Empire Casting House has established itself as a reputable manufacturer in the jewelry industry. The company's commitment to craftsmanship, innovation, and ethical practices has contributed to its growth and recognition.
Services
Empire Casting House provides a wide array of services to meet the diverse needs of its clients:
3D CAD Design and Printing: Utilizing advanced CAD software and 3D printing technology to create intricate and precise jewelry designs.
Casting: Offering casting services in various precious metals, including gold, silver, and platinum.
Setting: Expert gemstone setting services, ensuring secure and aesthetically pleasing placement.
Finishing: Providing meticulous polishing, tumbling, and quality control processes to achieve a flawless finish.
Ethical Sourcing: Emphasizing the use of certified and ethically sourced diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, and precious metals.
Memberships and Affiliations
Empire Casting House is a member of several prominent industry organizations, demonstrating its commitment to professionalism and ethical standards:
* Jewelers Board of Trade ([https://www.jewelersboard.com/ JBT])
* Manufacturing Jewelers & Suppliers of America ([https://www.mjsa.org/ MJSA])
* [https://www.rapnet.com/ RAPNET: The Diamond Market]
* [https://fairmined.org/suppliers-portfolio/empire-casting-house/ FAIRMINED]
Products
Empire Casting House has many patents in jewelry production and makes significant contributions to the industry. The company offers a diverse selection of jewelry products, including:
* Rings
* Necklaces
* Earrings
* Bracelets
* Pendants
